title: Fix Network page status text overlap
summary: Fix the Network page layout so lifecycle/status text is not hidden behind the saved-role metric tiles.
reason: The Network status evidence block can extend over the metric tile row at wide desktop widths, making text appear hidden underneath the tiles.
behavior_before: Network status text could visually overlap the saved-role, coordinator URL, worker poll, and local API tiles.
behavior_after: Network status evidence reserves its own layout space or scrolls within a bounded region before the metric tiles render below it.
manual_validation: in-app Browser visual check on temporary rendered WebView shell at 2048x720 - passed; network-status-banner-lines overflowX/overflowY auto, linesInsideBanner true, metricBelowBanner true, 8px gap
